svg.title: Perplexity is exponentiated average surprise
svg.desc: Perplexity exponentiates average token-level cross-entropy: PP=2^H for cross-entropy in bits, equivalently the inverse geometric mean of the held-out token probabilities. Lower is better only when comparing on the same test set and vocabulary.

g.text: Score held-out tokens with log loss, average it, then exponentiate; lower is better.
Use log probabilities; multiplying many tiny probabilities can underflow.
